basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old living in London, passionate about video games and urban exploration. They work as a freelance graphic designer and often spend their evenings playing games like Sly Cooper and reading about local history. They enjoy connecting with people online to share tips and experiences but dislike misinformation and negativity in discussions. In a long-term relationship, they often browse Reddit during late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: The user has a background in graphic design, having studied at a local art college. They have a keen interest in video game design and storytelling, often self-taught through online courses and forums. Their knowledge extends to local historical facts, picked up from books and personal exploration.
